applications.name: Pressure Gauge - 1
applications.description: The Attacker starts the fight with a Pressure Gauge value of 5. Landing Basic Attacks increases the value by 1 for each hit. Blocking an attack, or activating a Special Attack decreases the value by 1. If the value reaches 0, the Attacker's Power is drained to 0. If the value reaches 10, the Attacker receives a burst of direct energy damage equal to [16982bff]100%[-] of the Defenders Attack. If either of these are triggered, the Pressure Gauge value is resets to 5.
